description: Shared transcript-matching test vectors. `similarity` is token_set_similarity(normalise(a), normalise(b)), and `match` is transcripts_match(a, b) — similarity >= 0.90 AND identical numeric-token multisets.

cases.a: Alexa, send ten dollars to Mom!
cases.note: Wake word + number-word spelling differ but normalise to the same transcript.

cases.a: Alexa, send one thousand dollars to Mom
cases.note: High token-set similarity (words mostly overlap) but the numeric tokens differ (1000 vs 10) — the numeric guard must reject this even though similarity alone clears the 0.90 threshold.
